title: check_mergability_ghstack workflow seems to be silently broken
bug_description:
There's a "Check mergeability of ghstack PR" workflow that runs on every ghstack PR (see  https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/blob/main/.github/workflows/check_mergeability_ghstack.yml) but it's failing consistently while still returning a green signal

Example failure:
https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/17251984547/job/48956109456

```
2s
Run set -ex
+ python3 .github/scripts/trymerge.py --check-mergeability 161561
Found 2 PRs in the stack for 161561: [161452, 161561]
stdout: 
fatal: ref HEAD is not a symbolic ref

stderr: 

Found 2 PRs in the stack for 161561: [161452, 161561]
```

Spot checking this job logs from even 2 months ago ([example run](https://github.com/pytorch/pytorch/actions/runs/15572725189/job/43851758866)) shows the same failure.

Let's either fix this check or remove it if it's not useful

cc @seemethere @malfet @pytorch/pytorch-dev-infra
